name: aiworkstation-open-source-intelligence
description: One unified evidence-backed Skill plus live AI Workstation Radar MCP tools for discovering, verifying, comparing and selecting open-source AI projects and planning candidate AI stacks.

interface.longDescription: Use one unified Skill to browse AI Open Source Radar, find projects from requirements, verify project and license evidence, compare alternatives, and plan candidate open-source AI stacks. The host model performs the reasoning; the public AI Workstation MCP path supplies read-only Radar data and must not invoke AI Workstation server-side models.
defaultPrompt: Browse the current AI Open Source Radar and show the most relevant projects for my use case.
Find a self-hosted RAG platform with Docker and a Web UI. Keep hard requirements separate from preferences.
Compare Dify and RAGFlow for an enterprise knowledge base, separating evidence, assumptions, unknowns, and risks.
